observation: The new candidate-custody lane is a cheap current-head guard, not a long-running scientific receipt. Exact-SHA non-cancelling scheduling would preserve obsolete red guard jobs after a newer PR head exists and recreates avoidable pending-run inventory.
unchanged_invariant: a fingerprint/receipt/task-state red must remain red
heavy compression/runtime/external receipts remain exact-SHA and cancel-in-progress=false

refined_scheduling.candidate_custody_group: PR/ref scoped, same scheduling key class as the existing latest-head-impact classifier
refined_scheduling.exactness_source: EVIDENCE_HEAD checkout + explicit git rev-parse equality, not the concurrency key

ci_topology_fit: The current split-receipt topology checker requires PR/ref cancelling classifier custody plus exact-SHA non-cancelling result jobs; it does not require every cheap guard job to use exact-SHA non-cancelling scheduling.
benefit: Preserves Issue #130 truth while avoiding one durable pending custody job per superseded long-lived-PR commit.
kill: If cancelling an obsolete custody job can hide the current head's lock state, reject this refinement. The current head must always receive one exact-head custody result.
claim_boundary: CI scheduling/evidence-custody refinement only. No release, product, threshold, receipt or benchmark credit.
